# Dev headers for the sys crates, PLUS the runtime plugin packages — gst-backed
# tests construct real elements (webrtcbin lives in gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad,
# not in any -dev package).
# libasound2-dev supplies alsa.pc: without it the `alsa` crate's alsa-sys build
# script panics, and cargo reports it as a failed Clippy step rather than a lint.

libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-dev
libgstreamer-plugins-bad1.0-dev
gstreamer1.0-plugins-base
gstreamer1.0-plugins-good
gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad
gstreamer1.0-nice
libglib2.0-dev
libssl-dev
libasound2-dev
